substantive_finding: Both item types show statistically significant negative mode differences in Grade 4. Constructed response exhibits an incremental -3.0 pp gap (-6.8 pp vs -3.8 pp).
Constructed response difference (-6.9 pp) is almost identical to reading (-6.8 pp), pointing to a general response construction bottleneck (equations, diagrams, text) rather than keyboarding alone.
At Grade 8, mode differences attenuate substantially (-1.6 pp SR vs -2.0 pp CR), leaving a narrow -0.4 pp format gap as student digital fluency matures.
